title: At powers of two the cut-open torus's eigenvalue multiplicities are Kloosterman sums
subject: Networks of rings joined by shared contacts, read with the canonical knot test on their space-time law
conclusion: At sides 2^m every eigenvalue λ of the cut-open torus walk appears K(1/λ)(K(1/λ) − 2)/8 times, K the Kloosterman sum of GF(2n), that is (t² − 1)/8 for the elliptic curve with j-invariant λ, computed exactly for every class to side 128 and every eigenvector count to side 512. These multiplicities provably add up to the whole spectrum, so lower bounds alone would prove that every eigenvalue lies in GF(2n), which stays open.
